items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Well he was with Hal Kemp's band and they may have played that territory.

ctx.x: I don't know, it just seems to me that I remember him from the years back before he got on big time, he really hit the big time.
Well he was with Hal Kemp's band and they may have played that territory. I'm sure they did, they were all from there..........
What was the advantage of turning your band over to him?
